messages.subject: Re: Beginner - Help with Output Interpretation
parts:
This is a pretty complex model for a beginner. Did you run a mediation model and a moderation model and interpret those?

We don't know what the defined parameters are because we can't see your code, and presumably 'I' is the interaction effect?  How was it created? That's not a great name for a variable, by the way.

P-values of intercepts are generally not interesting - they are arbitrary and you don't care if they are significant.  (You can add a constant to your variables, and nothing that matters will change, except the intercepts/)

Variances are also uninteresting. A variance must be above zero - it's the sum of squares (or it could be zero, under unusual circumstances) unless something has gone wrong,  so the fact that it is statistically significant means it's not zero, which you were pretty sure about before you ran the model.

It appears that you have one statistically significant effect that might be interesting, which is M2 -> Y. If your defined parameters are the indirect effects, then they are not significant, so it doesn't look like you have evidence of an indirect effect. 

There are whole books on mediation (and whole books on  moderation, and whole books on mediation and moderation) so it's a little bit difficult to give general advice and citations. Do you have more specific questions?

Remember, the aim of  a statistical model is to try to uncover the truth. The aim is not to obtain a statistically significant result; not getting a significant result is not a failure, and doesn't mean that there's something wrong.

Jeremy



On Tue, 17 Oct 2023 at 14:12, Selan <rachel....@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello, 

I am a student and ran a moderated mediation model that had good fit with the following results. It came out with only M2-Y having a significant association, however, M1 and M2 intercepts as well as M1, M2, and Y variances were all significant. 

I apologize for such a beginner question, but can someone explain to me what this output means and how to interpret this?

Resources (e.g. citations, links) accompanying explanation would be greatly appreciated as well.

Thank you kindly for any guidance.
